reviews.question:
Advertisements are becoming more and more common in our everyday life.
Is it a positive or negative development?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, advertising has become an indispensable part of modern life. Consumers can encounter products advertised on television and social media every day. So, in my opinion, alongside its benefits, it also brings about many negative impacts.
From consumers’ perspective, commercials bring a truly convenient and helpful buying experience. Unlike decades ago, when people largely relied on local brands, nowadays consumers can easily access information about a wide range of products through TV advertisements, pop-ups on social networking platforms or street billboards. As a result, this exposes individuals to a wide range of goods available on the market and so they can make wiser purchasing decisions. On a far wider societal scale, advertising is a powerful driver of economic growth. The advertisements that have engaging content and appealing visual effects stimulate customers’ demand, encouraging them to purchase more products. This purchasing power will boost employment opportunities, while more revenue will be poured into the state budget.
However, the proliferation of advertising leads to disadvantages. Many audiences feel overwhelmed by the colossal number of advertisements, for example social network users have showcased their frustration about being constantly exposed to pop-ups of all types which can disrupt their online experience such as when they are gaming or watching films since they simply failed to turn them off until half a minute later. Moreover,  persuasive advertisements can lure or entice people into buying things that they may not otherwise need. This tendency is further reinforced by the endorsement of celebrities, who hold  strong social influence, making the promoted products more trustworthy and desirable. In this way, consumers, regardless of whether they are fans of these celebrities, can develop impulsive and wasteful buying habits. 
In conclusion, advertising helps consumers find information and supports the economy. However, it can also make people buy things they do not need and feel disturbed. Therefore, the development of advertising has both beneficial and harmful effects on modern society.

Tuy nhiên, Body 1 cần một câu chủ đề khái quát trước hai lợi ích; hiện em mở ngay bằng lý do cho người tiêu dùng. reviews.question:
The media should include more stories which report good news.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
It is argued that news coverage should focus more on good news. I partly disagree with this because although good news bring certain benefits, bad new plays an important role in informing people about social problems.
Admittedly, one might argue that reporting more good news can have a positive influence on people. Good news is often reported more frequently in some platforms and can offer certain advantages. In a way, it allows people to adopt more optimistic perspectives on the world and life. For example, Nick Vujicic, a man born without arms and legs, became a world-famous motivational speaker. He chose not to give up and now travels around the world to inspire others. However, I believe that such a proposal is quite difficult to implement in practice. Human beings are naturally drawn by breaking or shocking news, such as political scandals or natural disasters. Therefore, if news agencies reported mainly good news, they might be unable to attract enough viewers or readers. This could negatively affect their profitability and even lead to their collapse or bankruptcy.
More importantly, bad news can constantly warn people of existing and looming problems in society. For instance, a piece of news about a tragic accident in which a family of four lost their lives because the father was driving under the influence of alcohol could have a strong impact on the public. If people are constantly exposed to this kind of news, they are much more likely to avoid drunk driving or try to dissuade their friends and relatives from doing so. Therefore, by reporting tragic deaths caused by dangerous driving, media companies can help the public circumvent countless problems in life. In this way, negative news is not simply a source of fear or sadness, but can also encourage people to behave more responsibly.
In conclusion, although reporting more good news can encourage people to have a more positive outlook on life, I do not believe that the media should focus more heavily on it.
reviews.overall: Em viết đủ 333 từ và đã triển khai hai phần chính: thừa nhận lợi ích của tin tốt, rồi giải thích vì sao tin xấu vẫn cần được đưa tin. Tuy nhiên, mở bài nói “partly disagree” trong khi dàn ý yêu cầu không đồng ý và kết bài cũng bác đề xuất. Ví dụ Nick Vujicic mới kể về con người anh ấy, chưa cho thấy việc đăng một câu chuyện tích cực tác động đến người đọc ra sao. Em cần nối ví dụ với luận điểm, sửa mức độ của đề từ “more” thay vì “mainly”, rồi soát lại lỗi số ít và giới từ. Cô đã ghi rõ từng chỗ cần sửa trong bài.

reviews.question:
Some scientists think there are intelligent life forms on other planets and messages should be sent to contact them. Other scientists think it is a bad idea and would be dangerous.
Discuss both views and give your opinion.
reviews.originalEssay:
Some scientists believe that there are intelligent forms of life on other planets and we should send messages to contact them. Others thinks that this is a dangerous idea. I agree with the second view because contacting aliens may bring more risks than benefits.
On the one hand, there are currently many problems on Earth that seem to be insoluble, such as global warming, rising sea levels and animal extinction. These problems could eventually lead to the demise of our own race. Therefore, it is understandable why some scientists advocate the idea of sending messages to intelligent life forms on other planets. If we could contact civilizations that have successfully dealt with such problems, they might pass on their invaluable knowledge and help us avoid our extinction.
On the other hand, our technology is still insufficiently developed for space exploration, as seen in our failed attempts to send manned missions to Mars. If we contacted a civilization capable of travelling to Earth, their technology could have far exceeded ours. In this case, we might have little to gain by working and coexisting with humanity, except for being their test subjects or slaves. Moreover, there could be a risk of invasion. If they had superior technology, humans could be rendered helpless against their possible invasion. Therefore, contacting an unknown civilization could put the future of humanity at serious risk.
In conclusion, although contacting intelligent life forms on other planets could provide us with invaluable knowledge and help us deal with serious problems on Earth, I believe that the possible dangers are greater than the benefits. Therefore, we should not send messages to contact them.
reviews.overall: Em đã trình bày cả hai quan điểm, giữ lập trường phản đối việc liên hệ và viết đủ 273 từ. Các chuỗi về vấn đề trên Trái Đất, chênh lệch công nghệ và nguy cơ xâm lược đều có trong bài. Tuy vậy, mỗi thân bài đang mở bằng một lý do cụ thể mà thiếu câu chủ đề nêu ý chung; câu chốt ở Body 1 cũng đến trước phần giải thích lợi ích. Em cần sửa thêm chủ ngữ trong câu nói về việc cùng tồn tại: ở đó ý được giao là người ngoài hành tinh có ít lợi ích, không phải con người.

reviews.question:
Some people believe that powerful advertising can be harmful to individuals.
In what ways can advertising negatively affect people?
What solutions can be implemented to minimize its harmful effects?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, advertising has become an indispensable part of modern life. Some people argue that it has many different negative effects on viewers. This essay will, accordingly, provide insights into the problems and potential solutions to this phenomenon.
This situation has given rise to several pressing consequences, chief among them buying things that they may not otherwise need. This tendency is further reinforced by the endorsement of celebrities, who hold strong social influence, making the promoted products more trustworthy and desirable. In this way, consumers, regardless of whether they are fans of these celebrities, can develop impulsive and wasteful buying habits. Moreover, misleading advertisements exaggerate product quality and benefits, making consumers believe that these products are more effective or reliable than they actually are. As a result, consumers may make purchasing decisions based on false expectations, leading them to waste money on ineffective products and, in some cases, put their health at risk.
To address these problems, several feasible measures can be taken. One possible solution is that governments should adopt several measures to resolve this issue. There should be a restriction on the number of platforms on which a company is  permitted to market its products. With this measure, consumers would be protected effectively against information overload helping them avoid making unnecessary purchases. Another viable approach is to impose strict censorship on all advertisements. Several rigorous content checks need to be carried out before the release of any commercial to ensure that the product descriptions accurately reflect their true quality, thereby protecting consumers from misleading information.
In conclusion, advertising can have a number of adverse effects, but these effects can be mitigated through well-targeted and practical solutions. It is, therefore, essential that relevant parties make concerted efforts to address each consequence with specific and effective actions.
reviews.overall: Em đã trả lời cả hai câu hỏi, mở Body 1 bằng ý chung rồi phát triển hai tác hại; chuỗi người nổi tiếng quảng bá sản phẩm → mua sắm bốc đồng được viết rõ. Phần kiểm tra nội dung cũng khớp với tác hại do quảng cáo sai lệch. Tuy vậy, em chưa giải thích giới hạn nền tảng làm giảm mua sắm bốc đồng như thế nào; quá tải thông tin lại chỉ xuất hiện ở phần giải pháp. Nếu giữ nguy cơ sức khỏe, em cần nêu bước trung gian dẫn đến nguy cơ đó. Cô yêu cầu em sửa các mối nối này và soát lại cách diễn đạt ở hai câu được đánh dấu.

reviews.question:
Some people regard video games as harmless fun, or even as a useful educational tool. Others, however, believe that video games are having an adverse effect on the people who play them.
In your opinion, do the drawbacks of video games outweigh the benefits?
reviews.originalEssay:
There is an opinion that gaming is a recreational pastime and an effective teaching aid. Many others say that it brings a negative influence on those who engage in it. Although this trend is beneficial to a certain extent, I believe that the disadvantages it offers are far more pronounced.
Admittedly, this trend can bring some merits. Chief among these is that gamers can enter a virtual world, allowing them to do things unthinkable in reality such as racing, shooting or even killing, which offer novelty and excitement that few real-life pastimes can provide. Added to this is the fact that people who spend hours in gaming constantly think about strategies to win, thereby developing problem-solving, teamwork and decision-making skills. However, I strongly believe that team sports or debate clubs have the potential to help participants develop the same abilities while offering additional benefits. This avoids the risks of addiction and physical inactivity associated with gaming.
To add further credence to my assertion, I note that playing games often keeps players engaged for hours on end, which can lead to various consequences. Scoreboards, new goals and frequent rewards could make users feel a sense of achievement, encouraging them to continue playing. For instance, if children spend hours progressing through game levels, they will blindly pursue achievements or compete for a higher score than their friends. This addiction can have a negative impact on children's lives, leading to a lack of sleep, deteriorating eyesight and a sedentary lifestyle. They may even neglect their homework because they spend hours playing games, which can cause problems at school.
In conclusion, although gaming may bring some advantages, these benefits can also be gained through other activities and should not overshadow the potential for addiction or the negative effects on health and academic performance.
reviews.overall: Em đã viết đủ số từ, giữ rõ quan điểm hại nhiều hơn lợi và triển khai đúng hai lợi ích cùng các hậu quả Cô giao. Phần phản biện bằng thể thao đồng đội và câu lạc bộ tranh biện có hướng đúng. Em cần mở Body 2 bằng nhận định bao quát rằng tác hại trội hơn, rồi nối rõ việc chơi kéo dài với nguy cơ nghiện trước khi nêu hậu quả. reviews.question:
It is now possible for scientists and tourists to travel to remote areas with natural environments, such as the South Pole.
Is this a positive or negative development?
reviews.originalEssay:
In recent years, advances in transportation have enabled both researchers and holidaymakers to access remote natural environments, such as Antarctica. From my perspective, this can bring considerable benefits.
On the one hand, traveling to isolated natural environments may provide people with a one-of-a-kind experience. Despite the numerous tourist attractions worldwide, globetrotters still crave novelty. For example, when visiting an island unfamiliar to most people, they may learn about indigenous religious practices, feast their eyes on rarely seen plants and animals, try local food, and experience a completely different way of life. Granted, one might say that people can simply see these things on TV travel channels without traveling. However, such viewing is far inferior to experiencing these activities in person, as screen entertainment can never replicate the profound sensory impact of physical exploration.
On the other hand, the presence of researchers in these environments leads to scientific discoveries. Despite centuries of scientific research, much remains unknown about the natural world. Visiting remote environments may help scientists answer existing questions and prepare for future challenges. For example, new viruses continue to emerge, while global warming alters the habitats of elusive species in dense forests and the deep sea. A better understanding of these phenomena not only ensures that people are better prepared for potential outbreaks that could claim millions of lives but also provides valuable data for restoring damaged habitats.
In conclusion, I'm firmly convinced that the ability to travel to remote corners of the Earth is a highly advantageous development. It offers novel experiences for tourists and valuable scientific knowledge that is essential for future scientific progress and environmental protection.
reviews.overall: Bài của em đủ 270 từ và giữ rõ quan điểm đây là sự phát triển có lợi; hai đoạn thân bài lần lượt giải thích lợi ích cho khách du lịch và nhà khoa học. Phần ví dụ về đảo khá đầy đủ, nhưng “learn about” mới là tìm hiểu, chưa thể hiện việc tham gia tập quán như dàn ý giao. Ở đoạn khoa học, em cần thêm tác động đến đời sống loài vật, vận dụng bị động và tránh khẳng định quá chắc về khả năng ứng phó dịch bệnh. Cô cũng yêu cầu em viết đầy đủ “I am” và “television”, rồi tự soát lại bản sửa.

annotations.label: a1
annotations.title: Chưa thể hiện việc tham gia tập quán
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
“Learn about” là tìm hiểu thông tin; dàn ý giao trải nghiệm trực tiếp bằng cách tham gia tập quán bản địa. Các trải nghiệm còn lại em đã nêu đủ.

Thay bằng “participate in indigenous religious practices”.

anchors.quote: learn about indigenous religious practices

annotations.label: a2
annotations.title: Viết đầy đủ television
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
Câu mẫu của Cô có “TV”, nhưng yêu cầu viết bài hiện tại dùng dạng đầy đủ. Đây là điều chỉnh theo yêu cầu bài luyện, không phải lỗi ngữ pháp do em tự tạo.

Viết “television travel channels”.

anchors.quote: TV travel channels

annotations.label: a3
annotations.title: Giảm mức khẳng định tuyệt đối
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
“Never” khẳng định mọi trải nghiệm trên màn hình đều không thể tái tạo cảm giác nào, mạnh hơn điều cần chứng minh. Ý chính là trải nghiệm trực tiếp phong phú hơn.

Viết “cannot fully replicate the sensory impact of physical exploration”.

anchors.quote: can never replicate the profound sensory impact of physical exploration

annotations.label: a4
annotations.title: Vận dụng bị động ở chỗ phù hợp
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
Câu chủ động của em đúng, nhưng dàn ý nêu cả đời sống lẫn môi trường sống của loài vật bị tác động. Em thêm “lives” và có thể dùng bị động đã học để nhấn mạnh chính hai đối tượng ấy.

Viết “while the lives and habitats of elusive species in dense forests and the deep sea are being affected by global warming”.

anchors.quote: while global warming alters the habitats of elusive species in dense forests and the deep sea

annotations.label: a5
annotations.title: Hiểu biết giúp chuẩn bị, không bảo đảm
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
“Ensures” bảo đảm kết quả ứng phó; bằng chứng em nêu chỉ cho thấy hiểu biết có thể giúp chuẩn bị và cung cấp dữ liệu phục hồi. Em giữ hai kết quả nhưng dùng mức độ chính xác hơn.

Viết “can help people prepare for potential outbreaks that could claim millions of lives and provide data that can be used to restore damaged habitats”.

anchors.quote: ensures that people are better prepared for potential outbreaks that could claim millions of lives but also provides valuable data for restoring damaged habitats

annotations.label: a6
annotations.title: Tránh dạng rút gọn trong bài luận
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
“I'm” là dạng nói/viết rút gọn của “I am”, không phù hợp yêu cầu văn phong bài luyện này.

Viết “I am firmly convinced that..”.
